sentences.en: Avoiding one-use kitchen utensils, Elton forgoes apple corers, preferring the more versatile paring knife.
sentences.zh: 艾尔顿为了避免使用一次性厨房用具，放弃了苹果削皮器，更喜欢多功能的水果刀。

sentences.en: I think I can forgo this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可以省略这一步。

sentences.en: Tom had to forgo his morning swim, on account of it being too cold.
sentences.zh: 汤姆不得不放弃早晨游泳，因为天气太冷了。

senses.zh: 放弃；停止；对…断念 [ 过去式forwent 过去分词forgone 现在分词forgoing ]
